review_note: The source asserts closure of a target-τ-local morphism property under base change by a map in the corresponding class (flat/fppf/syntomic/smooth/étale/open). Draft preserves all choices and the prerequisite that P is local on target.
statement: A property $\mathcal P$ of scheme morphisms is *local on the target for the $\tau$-topology* if for every $\tau$-covering $\{Y_i\to Y\}$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$ if and only if each base-changed morphism $f_i:X\times_YY_i\to Y_i$ has $\mathcal P$. Let $\tau$ be one of fpqc, fppf, syntomic, smooth, étale, or Zariski, and let $\mathcal P$ be $\tau$-local on the target. If $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$, then its base change along any $g:Y'\to Y$ belonging to the corresponding class of maps—flat for fpqc; flat locally finitely presented for fppf; syntomic for syntomic; smooth for smooth; étale for étale; and an open immersion for Zariski—also has $\mathcal P$.
hypotheses: P is tau-local on the target; f has P; g belongs to the indicated class for tau.
conclusions: The base change f':X×_Y Y'→Y' has P.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-pullback-property-local-target}
Let $\tau \in \{fpqc, fppf, syntomic, smooth, \etale, Zariski\}$.
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a property of morphisms which is $\tau$ local
on the target. Let $f : X \to Y$ have property $\mathcal{P}$.
For any morphism $Y' \to Y$ which is
flat, resp.\ flat and locally of finite presentation, resp.\ syntomic,
resp.\ \'etale, resp.\ an open immersion, the base change
$f' : Y' \times_Y X \to Y'$ of $f$ has property $\mathcal{P}$.

review_note: Retains three sufficient criteria for τ-locality on target: preservation by corresponding base changes, Zariski locality on target, and descent from all surjective affine maps of corresponding kind; no extra full descent assumption.
statement: A property $\mathcal P$ of scheme morphisms is *local on the target for the $\tau$-topology* if for every $\tau$-covering $\{Y_i\to Y\}$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$ has $\mathcal P$ if and only if each base-changed morphism $f_i:X\times_YY_i\to Y_i$ has $\mathcal P$. Let $\tau$ be one of fpqc, fppf, étale, smooth, or syntomic, and suppose $\mathcal P$ satisfies all three assumptions: (1) $\mathcal P$ is preserved under base change by, respectively, flat morphisms (fpqc), flat locally finitely presented morphisms (fppf), étale morphisms (étale), smooth morphisms (smooth), or syntomic morphisms (syntomic); (2) $\mathcal P$ is local on the target for Zariski open coverings; (3) for any surjective morphism $S'\to S$ of affine schemes of the corresponding type and any scheme morphism $f:X\to S$, $\mathcal P$ for $f\times_SS'$ implies $\mathcal P$ for $f$. Then $\mathcal P$ is local on the target for arbitrary $\tau$-coverings.
hypotheses: P stable under the relevant base changes, Zariski-local on target and descending through surjective affine maps of the chosen type.
conclusions: P is tau-local on the target.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-descending-properties-morphisms}
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a property of morphisms of schemes over a base.
Let $\tau \in \{fpqc, fppf, \etale, smooth, syntomic\}$.
Assume that
\begin{enumerate}
\item the property is preserved under
flat, flat and locally of finite presentation, \'etale, smooth, or syntomic
base change depending on whether $\tau$ is fpqc, fppf, \'etale, smooth, or
syntomic (compare with
Schemes, Definition \ref{schemes-definition-preserved-by-base-change}),
\item the property is Zariski local on the base.
\item for any surjective morphism of affine schemes $S' \to S$
which is flat, flat of finite presentation,
\'etale, smooth or syntomic depending on whether $\tau$ is
fpqc, fppf, \'etale, smooth, or syntomic,
and any morphism of schemes $f : X \to S$ property
$\mathcal{P}$ holds for $f$ if property $\mathcal{P}$
holds for the base change $f' : X' = S' \times_S X \to S'$.
\end{enumerate}
Then $\mathcal{P}$ is $\tau$ local on the base.
